---
title: "2026 North Carolina Election Results"
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)
library(scales)

# Cache Census shapefiles locally so re-rendering is fast
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

nc_2026 <- read_tsv("data/results_pct_20261103.txt")

# Load continental U.S. state outlines from the built-in maps package
us_states <- st_as_sf(maps::map("state", fill = TRUE, plot = FALSE)) |>
  st_transform(4326)
```

## U.S. Senate Results by County

```{r}
# Summarize U.S. Senate vote totals and margin by county
senate_county <- nc_2026 |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE") |>
  summarize(
    dem_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "DEM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "REP"], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_votes = sum(`Total Votes`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = County
  ) |>
  mutate(dem_margin = (dem_votes - rep_votes) / total_votes)

# Join county shapes and transform to WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for leaflet
nc_counties <- counties(state = "NC", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  mutate(County = str_to_upper(NAME)) |>
  left_join(senate_county, by = "County") |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<strong>", NAME, " County</strong><br/>",
      "Roy Cooper (DEM): ", comma(dem_votes), "<br/>",
      "Michael Whatley (REP): ", comma(rep_votes), "<br/>",
      "Margin: ", ifelse(dem_margin >= 0, "DEM +", "REP +"),
      percent(abs(dem_margin), accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

# Center the red-white-blue color scale symmetrically at 0
senate_lim <- max(abs(nc_counties$dem_margin), na.rm = TRUE)
senate_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#b2182b", "#f7f7f7", "#2166ac"),
  domain = c(-senate_lim, senate_lim)
)

leaflet(nc_counties) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldStreetMap) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = us_states,
    fillColor = "transparent",
    color = "#666666",
    weight = 1
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~senate_pal(dem_margin),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 2, color = "#333333", bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = map(nc_counties$tooltip, htmltools::HTML)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = senate_pal,
    values = c(-senate_lim, senate_lim),
    title = "Dem - Rep Margin",
    labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = \(x) round(x * 100))
  )
```

## U.S. House of Representatives Results by District

```{r}
# Summarize U.S. House votes and candidate names for each of the 14 districts
house_districts <- nc_2026 |>
  filter(str_starts(`Contest Name`, "US HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES")) |>
  mutate(district = str_extract(`Contest Name`, "\\d+$")) |>
  summarize(
    dem_cand = first(Choice[`Choice Party` == "DEM"]),
    rep_cand = first(Choice[`Choice Party` == "REP"]),
    dem_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "DEM"], na.rm = TRUE),
    rep_votes = sum(`Total Votes`[`Choice Party` == "REP"], na.rm = TRUE),
    total_votes = sum(`Total Votes`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = district
  ) |>
  mutate(dem_margin = (dem_votes - rep_votes) / total_votes)

# Join congressional district boundaries and transform to WGS84 for leaflet
nc_districts <- congressional_districts(state = "NC", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  left_join(house_districts, by = c("CD119FP" = "district")) |>
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<strong>District ", as.integer(CD119FP), "</strong><br/>",
      dem_cand, " (DEM): ", comma(dem_votes), "<br/>",
      rep_cand, " (REP): ", comma(rep_votes), "<br/>",
      "Margin: ", ifelse(dem_margin >= 0, "DEM +", "REP +"),
      percent(abs(dem_margin), accuracy = 0.1)
    )
  )

house_lim <- max(abs(nc_districts$dem_margin), na.rm = TRUE)
house_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = c("#b2182b", "#f7f7f7", "#2166ac"),
  domain = c(-house_lim, house_lim)
)

leaflet(nc_districts) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldStreetMap) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = us_states,
    fillColor = "transparent",
    color = "#666666",
    weight = 1
  ) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~house_pal(dem_margin),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1.5,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(weight = 3, color = "#333333", bringToFront = TRUE),
    label = map(nc_districts$tooltip, htmltools::HTML)
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = house_pal,
    values = c(-house_lim, house_lim),
    title = "Dem - Rep Margin",
    labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = "%", transform = \(x) round(x * 100))
  )
```
